title: GOING OUT
author: Ensemble
question: Missing Data Art

increments.1: session 201: the dome for each report, the going-out to the chart matched, the lens, the twenty-year band

medium: An animated, interactive night sky in the browser: one Globe at Night report at a time, its sky set for its place and minute and taken away to what the observer saw; a lens that restores the sky where the visitor holds the pointer; a band of every report since 2006.
form: Canvas dome, animation, pointer lens, clickable band.
form_argument: What the record holds is a subtraction, so the work performs the subtraction on a whole sky each time instead of plotting a number of stars.
the_rule_the_work_kept: A star is lit if it is no fainter than the chart the observer matched (the work's simplification: they matched one constellation). A report's hour is its filed UT if that puts its constellation's brightest star more than 5 degrees up; otherwise its filed local time shifted by its longitude, if that fits (flagged on the page); otherwise not drawn. Reports at 0 N 0 E and reports with no chart are counted and not drawn.
sources: https://globeatnight.org/maps-data/ (Globe at Night, NOIRLab; yearly CSVs 2006-2025; CC BY 4.0; fetched 2026-10-24, sizes and SHA-256 in raw-manifest.json)
https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/V/50/catalog.gz (Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised ed., Hoffleit & Warren 1991, CDS VizieR V/50)
Kyba, Altintas, Walker, Newhouse, Science 379(6629):265-268, 2023, doi:10.1126/science.abq7781 (cited on the page for the 7-10 % a year and the 51,351 reports, from its abstract)

atlas_neighbours.title: ASTRES: Mapping the Firmament
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, the night sky is drawn in laser light to celebrate it. Here it is drawn so that it can be subtracted, one person's report at a time.

atlas_neighbours.title: Bathsheba Grossman's Crystal Engravings
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, astronomical data is fixed whole in glass. Here the whole sky appears only to be taken away, and comes back only where the visitor holds their eye.

atlas_neighbours.title: The Library of Missing Datasets (v2.0)
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, data that does not exist is filed as empty folders. Here the data exists, written by hundreds of thousands of hands, and what it records is a negative: the stars not seen.
